description: This file defines classes and interfaces for safe, reference-counted access to file descriptors, including the SharedFD class, FileInstance class, and related utilities. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' namespace and provides abstractions for managing file descriptors in a way that ensures proper lifetime management, thread safety, and POSIX compatibility.

classes.name: SharedFD
classes.description: A reference-counted, safe wrapper around a file descriptor, providing methods for duplication, socket creation, and other POSIX-like operations.

classes.name: FileInstance
classes.description: Represents the lifetime of a file descriptor, managing open/close operations and providing POSIX-like file operations.

classes.name: WeakFD
classes.description: A non-owning weak reference to a SharedFD, allowing to attempt to lock and obtain a SharedFD.

classes.name: ScopedMMap
classes.description: RAII wrapper for memory-mapped regions, ensuring proper unmapping.

classes.name: PollSharedFd
classes.description: Structure representing a file descriptor and its associated poll events.
